notes.title: Next Major Update Coming In April & Update On The Roadmap!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers, 

The 3rd major update is currently under development and will come in next month, April!

With 2 major updates already released, we have decided to rearrange our roadmap a little bit and release the 2nd community update before the last faction update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43140540/b10ff5d0a83eb8d5cee1284b411d91dae5a6819a.png

The next major update is going to be a community update and will focus on improving existing contents. There will be new contents as well such as a new companion to unlock, new skills and new equipment. Moreover, we are bringing steam achievements to Dungeon Dungeon! in the next update! So stay tuned!

As always, there will be a detailed list of changes and new content when the update comes out!

Kamen Yamada

notes.title: Announcing the Release Date!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

Thank you for your incredible support! Following Steam Next Fest and taking into account the feedback we received, we've been diligently improving Dungeon Dungeon! We're delighted to announce that Dungeon Dungeon! is now ready for play.

Get ready because Dungeon Dungeon! is launching on September 22nd this year!

We have decided to release the game as an early access title, which means you can start playing and exploring right away. But that's not all! Throughout the early access period, we'll be continuously adding new content and features based on your valuable feedback.

notes.title: A deeper look into the combat of Dungeon Dungeon!
notes.content:
Skills, Ults and Items
https://i.ibb.co/M63XqK0/image.gif
All units are able to perform actions including skills, ults and using items during their turns. There are over 30 skills each with its unique skill tree to upgrade with. Make sure to use skills with strategy since they have different costs. 
A wise adventurer would not go into dungeons without preparations. One small healing potion could sometimes save your valuable party member.

Positions and movement
https://i.ibb.co/KKd8FLN/1.gif
In combat, both adventurers and enemies have front positions and back positions. Units at back position are protected and take half of the damages if there are units at front. Moving wounded companions back would allow chances for healing and a comeback. 
Instead of simply moving forward or back, try to use skills that also move your companions to make the best out of it.

Attributes and effects
https://i.ibb.co/BG7SGZw/2.gif
There are all kinds of effects and buffs and debuffs. And they play a big part in the combat system of Dungeon Dungeon!. 
Even the weakest ground skeleton in the game could be fearsome if heavily buffed. So make sure to check all the buffs you can have before casting that high cost magic!

Summary
In the combat of Dungeon Dungeon!, planning is essential. Which skills to use? Or even skip the turn to act faster next? Which enemy to focus on? With different play styles and builds, these could all have different answers.

notes.title: Welcome Adventurers!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone

We have just announced Dungeon Dungeon! a few days ago, and it is great to see a lot of people showing interest.

You have probably read the description on the store page already. But here we want to show you more about the game and share some exciting screenshots and GIFs!

What to expect in Dungeon Dungeon! 
https://i.ibb.co/WWxdX1p/combat-Gif-0.gif
Turn-based Combat
Dungeon Dungeon! features a unique turn-based combat system. You will be able to change the unit's orders to take turns. Utilize the effect of skills, passives and equipment to delay the enemies or hasten your companions to exploit the weakness of the enemies and protect your companions.

Furthermore, by combining with the combo system, you can create a rampage of attacks to crush the enemies, or save your team from a seemingly certain defeat.

Party-based RPG
At the Early Access Release, there will be 6 companions in the game, each with unique initial skill and passives. There will also be unique permanent perks for each of the companions for you to unlock. More companions are to come with the updates during the EA period.

By defeating enemies and completing quests, companions gain experiences to level up. You will be able to choose new skills, upgrade existing skills, increase attributes, and choose adventurer classes for your companions. 
https://i.ibb.co/ScM90P2/screenshot-0.png
High Replayability
Having roguelike elements in the game, we aim to provide high replayability in Dungeon Dungeon!. Every playthrough will be different. You will encounter different enemies in different factions. You will have different skills to choose from. And naturally we would have a good variety of enemies, skills, equipment so that players would not get bored quickly.

With our unique combat system and the amount of skills and passives, there is a possibility for all kinds of different builds. We encourage you to try different play styles, different ways to develop companions and build your party. 

What happens now till the EA release
Dungeon Dungeon! is very much still in development. We are focusing on adding more contents, balancing and bug fixing to ensure that players would have the best gameplay experience when the game is released. We are also looking into the possibility to participate in Steam Next Fest in February 2023 and have a demo for everyone to try there. More info will come in the future if this is going to happen, so stay tuned!

Follow our twitter! https://twitter.com/DungeonNDungeon
We post more about our game on twitter weekly.

Join our Discord Server! https://discord.gg/xEQtNZFHb2

Cheers!
Kamen Yamada
